text: ORDINARY COUNCIL MEETING AGENDA  Winton Shire Council      Item 17.5 - 20 November 2025  371    17.5 EXECUTIVE MANAGER CORPORATE SERVICES REPORT  File Number: 198134  Attachments: Nil  Meeting Date: 20 November 2025       RECOMMENDATION  That the Executive Manager Corporate Services report for the Corporate Services Department’s  operations be received and noted.    REPORT  Human Resources  The workforce performance management review is progressing, with several outstanding reviews  occurring throughout the month.   An assessment of staff training requirements and needs has commenced to identify potential areas  for improvement, including individual focused training and organisational wide training. The  Council's online training portal is currently undergoing redevelopment in preparation for the  resumption of standard online training modules which will support the workforce capabilities.   Recruitment activity remains healthy, with numerous new hires across departments and ongoing  initiatives to fill key positions. However, some roles remain vacant due to challenges in attracting  qualified candidates.
